scenes.title: Truth in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Kabir explains how he accidentally swapped suitcases with Sudha on Monday's train and panicked at the gate.

scenes.title: Three Years of Silence
scenes.summary: At the front desk Pratap brings out the blue suitcase for Kabir, who explains his three-year silence with his brother Dev.

scenes.title: Friday Lemon Cake
scenes.summary: Sudha recalls what the brothers always ate after Friday piano lessons, giving Diya a bright baking idea.

scenes.title: Two Chairs Under the Tree
scenes.summary: Kavya, Diya, and Pratap arrange a quiet corner table under the courtyard tree and straighten the paper lanterns.

scenes.title: Simple Words First
scenes.summary: At eleven forty Kabir practices a stiff nineteen-point speech until Kavya helps him choose three simple, honest sentences.

scenes.title: Ten Minutes to Twelve
scenes.summary: At eleven fifty the postman drops off an official registered letter for Mohan, who sets it aside to greet noon.

scenes.title: Twelve Chimes
scenes.summary: Twelve o'clock strikes with an empty gate, Kabir loses hope for a long minute, and then a yellow taxi brakes outside.

scenes.title: The Red-Stamped Letter
scenes.summary: As Dev steps into the courtyard outside, Mohan opens the landlord's letter inside and turns pale at a commercial sale notice.
